prompt_md: Glass A has 100 mL of wine, glass B 100 mL of water. Pour 10 mL from A into B and stir. Then pour 10 mL from B back into A. How many mL of water are in A now?
prompt_short: 100 mL wine, 100 mL water, swap 10 mL each way. Water now in A?
hint_md: The 10 mL you pour back is a mix of water and wine.
explain_intuition_md: The spoonful going back isn't pure water: some of it is the wine you just added. Only 100 of B's 110 mL is water, so 10/11 of the pour is water.
